title: Randomized, controlled intervention study to evaluate the PhysioFit app as mobile physical therapy for pain, quality of life, and physical function in rheumatic patients
summary: This is an intervention study in rheumatology. Patients are randomly assigned to receive the PhysioFit app or a prescription for physical therapy. The respective intervention is then carried out for 8 weeks.

interventions.name: Intervention group: Patients receive the Physio-Fit app for 8 weeks. As part of the study, the app should be used 3 times a week for 15 minutes over 8 weeks, if possible. The practical application—the training—is selected. Individual body areas and fitness level (beginner/advanced) can be selected.
Control group: Patients receive a prescription for physiotherapy for a maximum of 60 minutes once a week, focusing on the spine.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients diagnosed with inflammatory rheumatic diseases (e.g., rheumatoid arthritis, spondyloarthritis (psoriatic arthritis, axial spondyloarthritis), myositis, scleroderma, vasculitis), patients at increased risk of developing inflammatory rheumatic diseases (psoriasis, anti-CCP-positive patients (preRA)), and patients with degenerative joint diseases (gonarthrosis) are being recruited for the study.
- Age > 18 years
- Written consent to participate in the study and data protection
- Willingness and ability to participate in the study; sufficient knowledge of German to understand the consent form and questionnaires, or, if this is not possible, information for participants and support in their native language or, if necessary, in English.
- High probability that patients will be able to participate in the full scope of the study.
- A signed consent form is required for all patients to participate in this study (the information and consent form is included with the application).
Exclusion criteria:
- Pregnancy
- No change in systemic immunosuppressive therapy in the last 3 months and during the intervention period (follow-up is excluded).
